Oil Refinery.cameo_hazmat_class: Class 3 - Flammable Liquid / Class 2.1 Flammable Gas
Oil Refinery.primary_disaster_risk: BLEVE (Boiling Liquid Expanding Vapor Explosion) & Toxic Aromatic Hydrocarbon Inhalation
Oil Refinery.firefighting_protocol: Aqueous Film-Forming Foam (AFFF), Alcohol-Resistant Foam, High-Volume Water Deluge to cool adjacent tanks

Petrochemical & Polymer Complex.cameo_hazmat_class: Class 2.1 / Class 3 - Flammable Monomers & Polymerization Hazards
Petrochemical & Polymer Complex.primary_disaster_risk: Uncontrolled Runaway Polymerization, Severe Pulmonary Edema, Vapor Cloud Explosion
Petrochemical & Polymer Complex.firefighting_protocol: Alcohol-Resistant Foam, Water Fog for vapor suppression (do not apply direct stream into molten polymer)

Fertilizer & Chemical Complex.cameo_hazmat_class: Class 2.3 - Toxic / Inhalation Hazard Gas & Class 5.1 Oxidizer
Fertilizer & Chemical Complex.primary_disaster_risk: Massive Detonation of Nitrate Stockpiles & Dense Alkaline Toxic Ammonia Vapor Cloud
Fertilizer & Chemical Complex.firefighting_protocol: Massive flooding with water from unmanned monitors. Do NOT attempt to fight Ammonium Nitrate fires in enclosed areas.

Chlor-Alkali & Basic Chemicals.primary_disaster_risk: Heavy Choking Green-Yellow Toxic Cloud Hugging the Ground & Rapid Hydrogen Explosions
Chlor-Alkali & Basic Chemicals.firefighting_protocol: Water spray curtain to knock down chlorine gas cloud (do NOT spray water directly on liquid chlorine leak source)

Thermal Power Plant.primary_disaster_risk: Coal Bunker Silo Dust Explosion & Dense Sulfurous Acid Particulate Smoke
Thermal Power Plant.firefighting_protocol: Inert gas smothering (Nitrogen/CO2 injection in silos), deluge water spray on conveyor belts

Iron, Steel & Smelting Works.cameo_hazmat_class: Class 2.3 / Class 2.1 - Toxic Flammable Gas Asphyxiant
Iron, Steel & Smelting Works.primary_disaster_risk: Molten Metal Water Steam Explosion & Acute Asphyxiation from High CO Flue Leaks
Iron, Steel & Smelting Works.firefighting_protocol: Dry Chemical Powder, Dry Sand for molten metal (NEVER USE WATER ON MOLTEN LIQUID METAL)

LNG & Cryogenic Gas Terminal.primary_disaster_risk: Rapid Phase Transition (RPT) Explosion, Cryogenic Frostbite, Massive Thermal Flashover
LNG & Cryogenic Gas Terminal.firefighting_protocol: High-Expansion Foam for vapor suppression, Dry Chemical for active fire extinguishment, Water curtain for exposure protection

Open Cast & Underground Coal Mining.primary_disaster_risk: Subsurface Coal Seam Smoldering, Methane Underground Detonation, Land Subsidence
Open Cast & Underground Coal Mining.firefighting_protocol: Nitrogen foam injection, High-pressure hydraulic sand stowing, Surface soil capping
